verdict.rationale: Unity is a development platform with cloud services such as multiplayer and build automation, so a sandbox or test environment separate from production data is a fair question. The evidence pack does not document any sandbox, staging, or isolated environment feature. Headless mode, command-line arguments, build automation and the MCP/CLI tooling are adjacent capabilities and do not isolate testing from production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
